summary: Tested the Magic Mariner 'Create <type> ZONE MAP for a <make> <model>...' feature on backend and frontend (390px, pro skipper test_session_pro_1, boat 'main'). Backend: 17/17 pytest pass (1 live test skipped by default). Results: status/image endpoints of the existing job, JPEG served, other user's job 404, unauth 401, bad ids 422, 400 when make+model are missing, unknown boat 404, empty image_ids 422, unknown ids 400, and use ['0','3'] adds 'Deck & cockpit' / 'Full interior' with different colours and servable images. One live job finished all 4 plans in about 10s. Frontend, all checks pass: (1) tapping zone-map-toggle with no maps auto-opens additional-details-dialog and expands Zone Map. zone-map-create-btn sits under maint-setup-open-btn and reads 'Create Yacht - Sloop ZONE MAP for a Beneteau Oceanis 38...'. (2) zone-plans-dialog: zone-plans-help shows the 3 seeded 'Admin - Help Panel - Zone Map Selection' lines, then 4 zone-plan-waiting 'Drawing...' tiles plus progress. Polling every ~3s produced 4 real plans in about 14s (images load, 1376px wide). Ticks toggle. Continue stays disabled with 'Select 1 or more plans', then reads 'Continue with 2'. (3) Continue closes both dialogs and shows the toast '2 layout plans added to your Zone Map'. Zone Map is expanded and scrolled to the top, showing 'ZONE MAPS (2)' with names Deck & cockpit / Full interior. (4) zone-plans-cancel-btn closes only the plans window. (5) Close reminder: Escape, X and Done each show zone-map-ask-dialog 'Create a zone map?'. 'Not now' closes it, and Escape on the reminder also closes it. 'Create zone map' re-opens details and plans and starts a job. (6) No reminder and no auto-open when zone maps exist. No reminder when the model is blank. (7) With the model blank, the button shows the toast 'Please fill in Make and Model first'. (8) Crew (free on TEST_Kia Ora): no zone map section, no create button, and mbp:open-details does nothing. Admin's default map tools are unchanged and nothing auto-opens. Regression passes: uploading a zone map photo, removing maps, POB showing 3, and maint-setup-dialog opening. No bugs found.

minor.issue: The background job is started with asyncio.create_task and no reference is kept, so the task could be garbage-collected mid-run (Python docs warning). Keep the task in a module-level set and discard it on done.

Each open of the plans dialog (Cancel then reopen, 'Create zone map' from the reminder, Try again) starts a new job and uses another Magic use. A job that already finished for the same boat/make/model is never reused, and a Cancel during drawing still costs a use. Consider reusing a recent done job for the same boat and make/model.
Finished jobs and plan images that are never picked are kept forever. There is no TTL index or cleanup.

action_items: Optional: keep a reference to the background generation task; reuse a recent finished job instead of using a new Magic use on each reopen; add a TTL/cleanup for zone_schematics.
critical_code_review_comments: zone_schematics.py: asyncio.create_task(_run(...)) result is not stored (risk of GC).
ZoneSchematicsDialog: start() runs on every open, so each reopen uses a Magic use. Consider caching the job_id per boat while it is running or done.

Launch-free promo (first200_cached) makes free users premium, so require_premium lets test-user-free start jobs on its own boat. This is expected while the promo runs. Note: my first test run started one live job as test-user-free, which used one Magic use; no maps were added.
seed_data_creation: Started 2 live jobs (test-user-pro a73c5c57..., test-user-free 52c77282...) from pytest, plus 1 live job from the UI (60ce2bc7...). All zone maps added to test-user-pro/main were removed (zone_maps: []). Boat make/model were cleared and then restored to Beneteau / Oceanis 38.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Live generation takes about 10-15s. To avoid using Magic uses in UI tests, intercept POST **/api/boats/main/zone-schematics with page.route and return {job_id: <cat /tmp/job>, total: 4}; the real poll and image endpoints then work. TestLive in test_zone_schematics.py only runs when ZONE_LIVE=1. Zone map items use the testid zone-map-item-<mapId>; names are in input fields. Crew boat for test-user-free is TEST_Kia Ora (it has a crew-agreement dialog; tap 'Not now').
